Interface FeatureFlagService

All Superinterfaces:
FastStatsService
public interface FeatureFlagService extends FastStatsService
A service for managing feature flags.

Attach it with contextBuilder.service(FeatureFlagService.create()) and read it back with context.service(FeatureFlagService.class).

Since:
0.24.0

    • getAttributes

      @Contract(pure=true) Attributes getAttributes()
      Returns the global targeting attributes configured for this service.

      These attributes apply to every flag defined by the service and are merged with any per-flag attributes supplied during definition.

      Returns:
      the global targeting attributes
      Since:
      0.24.0
